test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Impede
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Thwart'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Impede"** (रोकना) means to hinder or obstruct progress.
 
• **"Thwart" **(विफल करना) also means to prevent or obstruct.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Thwart'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Stalwart" **(मज़बूत) refers to someone loyal and hardworking.
 
• **"Stampede"** (भगदड़) is a sudden rush of a crowd.
 
• **"Sore"** (चोट) is either an injury or can describe feeling upset.
